# DayRun

> A playful, public-by-toggle calendar. Sign in with Google, sync your real calendar, and decide event-by-event what to show the world. Public profiles live at /u/[username] so friends, recruiters, or your group chat can see what you're up to.

## Pages

- [/](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/) — Home. What DayRun is and how it works.
- [/app](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/app) — Private dashboard for signed-in users. Sync Google Calendar, toggle individual events public.
- [/app/settings](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/app/settings) — Choose your username and toggle whether your public profile is reachable.
- [/u/[username]](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/u/charltonuw) — Public profile. Shows only events the user has marked public.
- [/about](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/about) — About the project.
- [/privacy](https://dayrun-app.netlify.app/privacy) — Data and privacy practices.

## How it works

1. User signs in with Google (read-only Calendar scope).
2. App pulls upcoming events into the user's private Firestore.
3. Each event starts private. The user toggles individual events public.
4. Public events show on /u/[username] — indexable, shareable.

## Built with

Next.js 16, Firebase (Auth + Firestore), Google Calendar API. Part of the azoni.ai launchpad portfolio.
